title: fix(rest): POST /api/v1/batch answers a request-schema refusal with fields[]
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

Fixes #34863
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`POST /api/v1/batch`（跨对象批量）请求体不合 schema 时，400 VALIDATION_FAILED 的回答从原样透出 zod `issues` 改为 ADR-0114 的 `fields[]`（`{ field, code, message }`），与同文件的单对象批量入口一致。
- 为什么改：客户端（含 `@objectstack/client` 的 `err.fields`）在这一个入口拿不到字段级错误，只能解析 zod 内部结构；ADR-0114 D3 要求 zod 在边界映射、不透传。
- 风险与回滚：只影响这一个拒收分支的回答体，成功路径与状态码不变；`issues` 键从该回答中移除（实测无客户端、SDK、测试或文档读取它）。回滚即还原 `batch-routes.ts` 一处 hunk。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` 第 308–322 行（唯一行为改动）；`packages/rest/src/cross-object-batch-request-refusal-fields.test.ts`；`.changeset/34863-cross-object-batch-refusal-fields.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/cross-object-batch-request-refusal-fields.test.ts`，预期 3 passed；以管理员 `POST /api/v1/batch` 发 `{"operations":"x"}`，预期 400 且回答带 `fields:[{field:'operations',code:'invalid_type',…}]`、不再带 `issues`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`: the cross-object batch door's request-schema refusal now maps the `CrossObjectBatchRequestSchema` failure through `zodIssuesToFields(issues, input)`, the same mapper every per-object batch door in this file already uses (`/data/:object/batch`, `createMany`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`). Status (400) and `code` (`VALIDATION_FAILED`) and `error` text are unchanged.
- `issues` dropped, not kept beside `fields`. Measured readers: no `packages/client` source reads `issues` off a batch refusal, `CrossObjectBatchResponseSchema` is the success shape only, no test or doc page names the batch refusal's `issues`, and every `body.issues` reader in `packages/rest` tests is a metadata-save route (422 INVALID_METADATA), not `/batch`. Keeping it would pass Zod through at the boundary, which ADR-0114 D3 forbids.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/rest` patch, with the migration sentence (`issues[i].path` reads as `fields[i].field`).
- Envelope position (#9559) untouched.

## Tests

New `packages/rest/src/cross-object-batch-request-refusal-fields.test.ts`, three cases: the card's two bodies (`{"operations":"x"}` gives `operations`/`invalid_type`; `{}` gives `operations`/`required`) plus an operation missing its object (`operations.0.object`/`required`). Each asserts status 400, `code` VALIDATION_FAILED, every `fields` element parses against `FieldErrorSchema`, no `issues` key, and no engine write or transaction reached.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-② no, measured: after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/rest^...' build` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build`, `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` contains neither `Invalid batch request` nor `VALIDATION_FAILED` (the literal lives only in `dist/index.js`); the refusal body is an untyped `res.json` literal, and `@objectstack/spec/api` exports no cross-object batch error schema. Nothing exported widens or narrows.
- No out-of-scope findings.
